name: Government action code
description: Code specifying a type of government action such as inspection, detention, fumigation, security.

values.name: Clearance
values.description: Clearance The cargo will be or has been cleared.

values.name: Detention
values.description: Detention The cargo has been or will be detained.

values.name: Fumigation
values.description: Fumigation The cargo has been or will be fumigated.

values.name: Inspection
values.description: Inspection The cargo has been or will be inspected.

values.name: Security
values.description: Security The cargo has been or will be secured.

values.name: Means of transport admittance
values.description: Means of transport admittance The means of transport will be or has been admitted.

values.name: Cargo hold inspection
values.description: Cargo hold inspection The cargo hold has been or will be inspected.

values.name: Container inspection
values.description: Container inspection The container has been or will be inspected.

values.name: Cargo packaging inspection
values.description: Cargo packaging inspection The cargo packaging has been or will be inspected.

values.name: Export certificate not required
values.description: Export certificate not required Indication by exporter that they do not need certificate of export from Customs.
